config.mode: The RoboAgent **Mode** the Create / Build / Debug toolbar buttons act on. The per-workspace choice made with *RoboAgent: Select Mode* takes precedence; this setting is the fallback for new workspaces.
config.mode.ros2: ROS2 — colcon workspace (ament packages, launch files)
config.stm32.toolchainPath: Directory containing `arm-none-eabi-gcc` and friends. Leave empty to use the toolchain on `PATH` (auto-discovered in `/usr/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `~/.local/xPacks`, `/opt/gcc-arm-none-eabi*`).
config.stm32.openocdInterface: OpenOCD debug probe interface config used by generated STM32 launch/flash tasks (`interface/<value>.cfg`).
config.esp32.idfPath: Path to an ESP-IDF checkout (`IDF_PATH`). Leave empty to use `$IDF_PATH`, then `~/esp/esp-idf`, then the ESP-IDF extension's current setup.
config.esp32.port: Serial port for flash/monitor (e.g. `/dev/ttyUSB0`). Leave empty to let `idf.py` auto-detect.
config.ros2.distro: ROS 2 distro to source for colcon/ros2 commands (e.g. `humble`, `jazzy`). Leave empty to use `$ROS_DISTRO`, then the newest distro under `/opt/ros`.
taskdef.mode.name: RoboAgent mode task name
